grammar.0.note: Plusquamperfekt = the event that happened earliest; Präteritum/Perfekt = the later event. nachdem + Plusquamperfekt, main clause in the Präteritum.
grammar.1.note: als = a single past event; wenn = repetition. For example: Wenn ich Zeit hatte, besuchte ich ...
grammar.2.note: This is a personal account; keep history and personal experience apart in your mind. In real life, listen to other people's history with respect.
